projects.title: Projects

stage.reasonHint: Required for block, return and reopen.

stage.documentsHint: Only links are stored, never files.
stage.author: Author

stage.subject: Subject

gate.title: Gate (closing conditions)
gate.notPassed: Gate not passed; the step cannot be closed.

failure.pending_feature: evaluated from phase {details}; not met until then
failure.questionnaire_initial_phase: questionnaire is still in the initial phase
failure.no_rules: no rules for this step in the catalogue (run the rule import)

questionnaire.title: Customer questionnaire
questionnaire.advanceHint: Possible once all mandatory initial items are filled in.
questionnaire.readOnly: Read only: the questionnaire is filled in by OAM.
questionnaire.frozen: Step 7 is closed; the questionnaire is frozen.
questionnaire.fictitious: Enter fictitious data only (v1 must not contain confidential data).
questionnaire.medium: Project medium: {medium} (questions depend on the medium)

designBasis.title: Design Basis
designBasis.description: Structured inputs from the questionnaire. Quantities are stored in SI with the entered value and unit.
designBasis.empty: Design Basis is empty: the questionnaire has no answers yet.

safety.title: Safety Review
safety.draftLabel: DRAFT, not a basis for design approval
safety.staleOverrides: Overrides and reviews that no longer apply (rule version or inputs changed). The result blocks again and must be reassessed.

design.title: Design checklist (P&ID and equipment)
design.description: Inputs for the P&ID rules (step 4). Filled in by OAM, OPS, ROC, Process Safety and Sizing.
design.frozen: Step 4 is closed; the checklist is frozen.

geometry.title: Dimensions for rule checks (v{version})
geometry.description: Geometric inputs for this layout version. Rules use the latest version.

rulesAdmin.title: Rules
rulesAdmin.description: Rules are data. Every change creates a new DRAFT version. Only Process Safety may set VERIFIED, after all parameters and the source citation are filled in.
rulesAdmin.readOnly: Admin and Process Safety may edit; only Process Safety may verify.

standardsAdmin.title: Standards (step 5)
standardsAdmin.description: Candidates from SPEC §7.3. Not a final list: Process Safety verifies revision and validity. Editing resets a standard to DRAFT.

sizing.title: Step 8: Sizing and autonomy
sizing.record: Save a new sizing result version
sizing.recordHint: Every save creates a new immutable version. Inputs, result and source (file, revision, author, date) are required.
sizing.readOnly: The sizing result is entered by the Sizing responsible.
sizing.frozen: Step 8 is closed; sizing is frozen.

autonomy.title: Backup autonomy (informative)
autonomy.conservative: Conservative (Q_peak the whole time, used for R-CAP-01)
autonomy.notMeets: Does not meet the requirement (R-CAP-01 NO-GO)
autonomy.usable: Usable liquid volume = V_tank · fill_max · (1 − heel_fraction)
autonomy.gas: Gas volume (normal conditions) = usable volume · expansion_ratio

calcAdmin.title: Autonomy calculation parameters
calcAdmin.description: Configurable parameters without default values (SPEC §6). Editing creates a new DRAFT version; only Process Safety sets VERIFIED.

export.title: Export: Design Basis & Safety Review
export.description: Includes the app version, rule versions and status, date, the exporting user and all overrides (in red). Every export is recorded in the audit log.

plan.title: Plan (coordinates) v{version}
plan.description: Plot plan objects in local coordinates [m]. Distances for the rules are derived edge-to-edge (tank and vaporizer to the other objects). Objects missing from the plan are not derived.
plan.label: Name
plan.invalidPoints: Invalid points (format: x, y; x, y).
plan.closedNeeds3: A closed shape needs at least 3 points.
plan.none: The plan has no tank or vaporizer and target objects yet.
plan.outside: Outside the site boundary: {list} (distance to boundary = 0).
plan.pointsHint: Enter a rectangle as four corners and tick “Closed shape”. The site boundary must be closed.
